summary.text: Keith Elliott is a Republican state representative who has represented Missouri House District 153 since 2025 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Elliott is a cattle rancher and a longtime Missouri Department of Transportation employee.

paragraphs.text: Keith Elliott was born in Poplar Bluff, Missouri.
His career experience includes working as a cattle rancher and for the Missouri Department of Transportation for almost 30 years.
Elliott took office on January 8, 2025, succeeding Darrell Atchison, and for 2025-2026 Ballotpedia lists him on the Corrections and Public Institutions Committee.
